sloka: भरद्वाजो महर्षिस्तं ब्रुवन्तं भरतं तथा ।प्रत्युवाच महाबुद्धिरिदं वचनमर्थवत् ॥ २.९२.२८॥
transliteration: bharadvājo maharṣistaṁ bruvantaṁ bharataṁ tathā ।pratyuvāca mahābuddhiridaṁ vacanamarthavat ॥ 2.92.28॥

translations.english: Hearing the words of Bharata, the great sage, wise Bharadwaja replied with meaningful words:
